GlxR.description: Global cAMP-dependent transcriptional regulator controlling carbon, energy, and stress metabolism in C. glutamicum

SugR.description: DeoR-type transcriptional repressor of genes encoding enzymes of glycolysis and sugar transport

Lrp.description: Leucine-responsive regulatory protein controlling amino acid biosynthesis and exporter genes

AmtR.description: Master repressor of nitrogen starvation response genes including ammonium and urea transport

RamA.description: LuxR-type transcriptional activator of acetate, ethanol, and gluconeogenesis pathways

RamB.description: Transcriptional repressor of acetate and fatty acid metabolism genes during growth on glucose

McbR.description: TetR-family regulator controlling sulfur assimilation and methionine/cysteine biosynthesis

DtxR.description: Iron-dependent global regulator controlling iron acquisition, storage, and heme utilization

RipA.description: Iron-responsive AraC-family regulator repressing aconitase and succinate dehydrogenase under iron deficiency
